name: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC)
statement: A transcription of the Leningrad Codex published at tanach.us, which states that "All biblical Hebrew text, in any format, may be viewed or copied without restriction." No licence conditions attach to the text itself; this project nonetheless asks that tanach.us be credited as the source. See https://www.tanach.us

evidence.quote: You may view or copy all biblical Hebrew text, in any format, without restriction.
